messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — candidate Taylor Nguyen (Sr. Infra Eng) is scheduled hybrid for Thu 2026-11-10. Need to lock panel times, loaner laptop, parking pass, VPN test access, and dietary prefs. @Ravi Singh can you handle hardware + preloads? @Alex Kim please confirm panel availability. I will send stipend + travel confirmation after we finalize.

Ravi Singh: Got it. Reserving a loaner MacBook Pro 16 (will image with brew + basic tools). Candidate OS preference? I'll arrange pickup at front desk 09:00–09:30 PT and leave a sticky with return instructions. Do we need any preloaded corp VM images for the hands-on?

Alex Kim: I can do 11:15–12:30 PT. @Nia Gomez are you free around then? I'll create 30/45 min slots and share. Planning: short design + 45m coding/whiteboard.

Nia Gomez: 11:30–12:15 PT works for me. Will join remotely if needed. Buffer ok for handoff.

Liam Ortega: Candidate lands 09:45 PT, prefers vegetarian lunch, and needs an accessible parking pass. Candidate asked about hybrid buffer for remote interview if traffic; ok to offer 30m slack. Also note: candidate requests a remote test URL and an ssh test host. I'll post travel itinerary in their calendar invite.

PeopleOps Bot: Badge request submitted for Taylor Nguyen — badge will be ready at front desk at 08:50. Parking permit code: PRT-1245 (front desk to print).

Maya Chen: Great. VPN quick test — please ask candidate to run this 24h prior and report results in DM or here. Paste this in their invite: 
```
VPN test steps:
1) Install OpenVPN Connect (or use built-in client)
2) Import config: redwood-candidate.ovpn
3) Connect and verify: curl -I https://internal.redwood.ai/status
4) SSH smoke test: ssh tnguyen@10.0.5.12 -p 2222 (use provided key)
```

Ravi Singh: I'll preload the SSH key and the test script, then DM the candidate for OS preference. Will complete imaging + VPN probe by Wed 18:00 PT and report here.

Maya Chen: Perfect — I'll update the calendar invite with parking code, badge pickup instructions, and the VPN steps. Sending confirmation email now. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Invite sent and tentative panels added. Leaving 15m between panels for recap.

Liam Ortega: I emailed candidate itinerary and expense policy (people-ops@redwood.ai copy). Taylor confirmed veg lunch and accessibility note.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — will follow up if anything changes.
